answer: At the loom the weaver will not throw the shuttle until the warp is counted and the tally is pinned to the beam, for cloth woven short cheats the buyer and the guild both. Lighthouse keeper lamp log with trinity house attestation is the pinning that proves the yardage: ten-year log, nightly lamp lit, oil accounts, yearly inspection. Weave under a counterfeit plume and the piece is cut from the loom, the weaver pays the yarn's value and the zenith besides, while the haven is recorded in the guild book and read when the quarter closes.
